content.title: How to Vote on 'American Idol' 2026: Online, Text and Social Media Voting Guide
content.text: The voting has been turned over to America on American Idol. So to make sure your voice is heard, here are the three ways to vote for your favorite to make it through to the finale. Here is how to cast your ballot at either AmericanIdol.com/Vote, via text, or on social media. You can vote 10 times per voting method for a total of 50 votes for your favorite if you use all the methods below.How to vote for the American Idol winner for 2026You have three options in the American Idol voting system this year: AmericanIdol.com/vote, via text, or on social media.You have to be at least 16 years old and located in the U.S., Puerto Rico or the U.S. Virgin Islands to vote on ABC.com and at least 18 years old and located in the U.S. to vote on social.🎬 SIGN UP for Parade's Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬When can I vote for American Idol?Voting for American Idol continues on Monday, March 23rd at the beginning of the East Coast broadcast at approximately 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT and locks at 6 a.m. ET/3 a.m. PT on March 24th. Check AmericanIdol.com/vote to find out when to vote each week for the rest of the season.Related: American Idol 2026 Results Last Night: Who Went Home and Who Made the Top 20?How often can I vote for American Idol?There is a limit of 10 votes per contestant per method each episode for a total of 50 across all voting methods.How to vote at AmericanIdol.com/voteGo to AmericanIdol.com/vote and register. Then you simply sign in and click on the artist you wish to vote for and assign that artist the number of votes you wish to cast. Then click the Save button. This voting method allows up to 10 votes per contestant. Don’t forget to save when entering or updating your votes!How to vote using American Idol Social MediaFor the first time in Idol history, you can vote on social media. Head to @AmericanIdol on Facebook, Instagram or TikTok. In the official pinned social media post, comment with the name of the hopeful you are voting for.You can write one name per comment. It equals one vote. You can vote 10 times per voting method. Only the first finalist named in your comment will receive your vote. You must comment additional times (up to 10 per finalist) to cast multiple votes. You must be at least 18 years old and located in the U.S. to vote on social media platforms.American Idol text votesFor American Idol text votes, simply text the voting numbers of the contestant you would like to vote for to “21523”. The voting number for each contestant will displayed during each night's performances. Message and data rates may apply.Jake Thistle Text 2 to 21523Daniel Stallworth Text 4 to 21523Kyndal Text 5 to 21523Jesse Findling Text 7 to 21523Hannah Harper Text 8 to 21523Braden Rumfelt Text 9 to 21523Brooks Text 10 to 21523Philmon Lee Text 11 to 21523Rae Text 12 to 21523Lucas Leon Text 13 to 21523Jordan McCullough Text 14 to 21523Chris Tungseth Text 17 to 21523Julián Kalel Text 19 to 21523Keyla Richardson Text 20 to 21523American Idol airs Monday nights at 8 p.m. ET/PT on ABC.Next, American Idol Returns in 2026 with Three Game-Changing Shake-UpsThis story was originally published by Parade on Mar 24, 2026, where it first appeared in the TV section.
